extra_quotes: Vector network analyzer measurements demonstrate broadband transmission through the complete electrical path up to the specimen.

The electrical path combines vacuum -compatible coaxial transmission lines with miniaturized impedance-controlled printed circuit boards and was experimentally characterized by S -parameter measurements over the full 0–20 GHz range.

In the four -channel version, however, the restricted lateral space available for two adjacent GSG transmission structures inevitably limits perfect impedance matching over the entire frequency range.
